[{"streamId":"01a1881b-5293-71eb-ad34-5ecee76868de","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1881b-5293-71eb-ad34-5ecee76868de\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022Every Linear interaction in tests runs against recorded Linear responses; no test and no build session calls a live Linear workspace\u0022,\u0022h9k connection add linear takes the API key the way h9k connection add jira takes its token: prompted by default and stored in the install\\u0027s own credentials directory (never inside a project, never replicated), or named with --token-env or, on macOS, --keychain; it probes Linear\\u0027s viewer query, refuses a rejected key with the remedy, and records the viewer\\u0027s id and name on the connection; the connection records only the credential reference\u0022,\u0022One Linear connection per install, refused on a second exactly as Jira\\u0027s is\u0022,\u0022h9k project set \\u003Cproject\\u003E --linear \\u003CTEAM\\u003E binds a default team for new issues after confirming with Linear that the team key exists, refusing an unknown key on the spot; \\u0027none\\u0027 clears it\u0022,\u0022Binding a Linear team is what makes Linear a project\\u0027s one tracker: on a project with --linear set, h9k task add --from-jira or --from-issue and h9k task link-jira or link-issue are refused, naming Linear as the project\\u0027s tracker; binding Linear on a project with a Jira board bound is refused, naming the board; a project with no Linear binding behaves exactly as today (the single tracker setting of idea c14bfb15 later replaces this rule without undoing it)\u0022,\u0022Changing a project\\u0027s tracker later stays possible: existing task links keep their provider and remain readable and closable as history, and only new links must match the new tracker\u0022,\u0022h9k task add --from-linear \\u003Cidentifier or URL\\u003E and h9k task link-linear \\u003Ctask\\u003E \\u003Cidentifier\\u003E read the issue through Linear\\u0027s API, accept an issue from any team the key can see (no bound-team check), and record it as linear:\\u003Cidentifier\\u003E\u0022,\u0022Adoption maps Linear state types: backlog, unstarted, and started adopt; completed, canceled, and duplicate are refused; triage is refused with a pointer to h9k idea add --from-linear\u0022,\u0022When Linear answers not found for a linked issue, the refusal says the issue may have moved to another team (which gives it a new identifier) and names h9k task link-linear \\u003Ctask\\u003E \\u003Cnew identifier\\u003E as the relink\u0022,\u0022An HTTP 200 response carrying a GraphQL errors array is treated as a failure, and a 429 RATELIMITED response maps to an outage with its Retry-After\u0022,\u0022h9k doctor probes the Linear connection when a project\\u0027s tracker is Linear, distinguishing no connection from a rejected key\u0022,\u0022h9k task show renders a Linear link as the issue\\u0027s web URL\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-29T15:30:35.339423\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"5f8a9749-5eb9-47a3-a8fe-74560f769e40","originSequence":140063,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-29T15:30:35.348805+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"}]
